subject: Don't include config.h from serverassert.h (#404)
reason: The change only removes the #include of config.h from serverassert.h and inlines equivalent definitions of valkey_unreachable and likely (same __builtin_unreachable/abort and __builtin_expect expansions guarded by the same GCC version checks). The assert/panic macros expand identically on both builds; this is a build/header-dependency refactor with no behavior change, so there is nothing a runtime scenario could distinguish.
